name: Evidence format and validator
description: The evidence contract for the reasoning-agent -> Jev method. Evidence structure and scenario contracts are defined in Pkl (Evidence.pkl, Scenario.pkl); the feature installs the pinned pkl runtime, those modules, an 'evidence-validate' bin (Pkl format check + filesystem grounding of each excerpt) and the Python adapter that runs Pkl-defined scenarios (mode guards, evidence-to-Jev transform). No case data.

pklVersion.description: Pkl release to install (only the default is checksum-pinned).
